Allow installing updates

To install new versions, Android needs you to allow this app to install apps. Open the setting and turn on the permission for T.A.R.K.A.S. The app only installs its own updates, checked against the published signature, and never while music is playing.

Update now

This is the development build, signed with a different key from the published one. For that reason it does not update itself: Android would refuse the install or erase the data. It only tells you when a new version exists. To update it, install through adb.
